# Retro Nim UI (retroui)

> A Windows 3.1 style, immediate-mode UI toolkit for Nim by Sultan Al Isaiee (@foxoman): one code base for Windows, macOS, Linux/BSD (X11, Wayland, or a screen with no desktop), Android, iOS and the web (WebAssembly from clang alone), with nothing to install (its own fonts, icons, PDF writer, image decoders), and the store packages made in Nim (`retrokit aab`, `msix`, `sign`, `mac`, `ipa`, `web`). Install with `nimble install retroui`; apps start with `import retroui` and `app "Title", w, h: ...`.

## Docs

- [The syntax, studied](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/docs/syntax.md): every form of writing an app as a small program with a picture of what it draws (row widths, binding, events, containers, dialogs, ids in loops), how it is built, why it is easy to follow, the rules
- [README](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/README.md): what is in the kit, how it works, every module; `retrokit run --window` shows an app as a desktop window on Termux:X11, `--live` builds it again on every save
- [Controls](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/docs/controls.md): every control with its signature, an example and pictures
- [Retro Designer](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/docs/designer.md): `retrokit designer app.nim`, the visual designer in the manner of Qt Designer: the file's windows drawn with the real controls, every change (controls dropped, moved, grouped, properties, events) written into the same `.nim` file; your editor for the code (the file locked to one of them at a time); built once per computer on Windows, macOS, Linux/BSD and Termux
- [Building](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/BUILDING.md): desktop apps (Windows from any system, macOS, Linux AppImages; Wayland and the screen driver), web pages, Android APKs and App Bundles without the SDK or NDK, iOS on a Mac, signing for every store (Authenticode with time stamps, MSIX, Developer ID and notarization, upload keys)
- [Security](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/SECURITY.md) and [third-party notices](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md): how to report a problem, what the kit does to be safe, what an app ships of others'
- Maps: `tileMap(state, source)` (`retroui/tilemap`) is a street map from any service (OpenStreetMap, Google, Azure Maps, Mapbox, HERE, MapTiler, Esri, TomTom, Stadia, AMap, Tencent, Tianditu) or your own PMTiles, MBTiles, folders, vector tiles drawn by the kit; `retroui/geo` finds places and routes with 13 services (`geocode`, `route`, `geocodeAsync`); `mapView` is the built-in world map
- 3D: `view3d(scene, cam)`; `loadGltf("car.glb")` (`retroui/gltf`; `.blend` through Blender: `loadModel3`, `retrokit model`) gives parts (`turnNode`, `setVisible`, `tint`, `recolor`), clips (`play`, `animate`), bones and shapes; drawn on the CPU or the GPU
- Media and devices: `videoView` in the window everywhere, `setNowPlaying`/`mediaKeys` (`retroui/mediasession`: lock screen, taskbar, Now Playing), `cameraView`, `cameraPhoto`, `recordSound` (`retroui/capture`)
- More windows: `window(open, "Tools", 240, 360): ...` opens a window of the system's own (a dialog on phones and in the browser)
- [The system's features](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/docs/system.md): `retroui/system` -- `notify`, `share`, `location`, `speak`, `haptic`, `setOpenAtLogin`, `requestAttention`, `deviceInfo`... the same calls on every system and in a web page, each system's answer and what an app declares for it; updates inside the app, signed (`retroui/update`, `retrokit update-key`, `update-sign`)
- Web pages (`retrokit web`): threads with `--threads` (Web Workers on one memory), the camera, the media keys, secrets (WebCrypto), signing in (a pop-up), chat over a WebSocket, the 3D view on WebGL 2, screen readers (ARIA); Retro Mail runs as a page (`--threads-only`)
- Android: `retroapk` lists the permissions the app's code needs by itself (camera, microphone, notifications, the place, vibration, the network); a crash (Nim, native, Java) is shown at the next start before the app runs (`stoppedScreen`; `stoppedFrame` for an app with its own loop; `startFresh`); builds in Termux run at most four compilers (`--jobs:N`)
- Checks: `sh tools/cicheck.sh` (what GitHub's CI runs), `sh tools/warncheck.sh` (no warning in the kit's files on any system)
- [API stability](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/docs/stability.md): what is settled before 1.0, what still moves, how a change reaches you
- [Changes](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release (newest first)
- Web pages: `webView(url, engine = weSystem)` is the system's own browser (WebView2, WKWebView, WebKitGTK, Android's WebView) placed in the window, loaded at run time; its scripts post to the app (`retro.post(text)` -> `WebEvent.messages`), the app posts to them (`webPost`) and runs scripts with answers (`webRun` -> `WebEvent.results`), keeps them to trusted hosts (`webAllow`), says what they may use (`webPermit`), serves the app's own pages (`webAppFolder`, `webAppUrl`), prints them (`webPrint`); under the app's menus a picture of the page stands in. The kit's own engine (`weKit`, the desktop default) draws local HTML itself.
- Screen readers (AT-SPI/Orca, UI Automation/NVDA and Narrator, VoiceOver, TalkBack) read every control by itself; `accessNode` and `accessName` for what an app draws itself. Input methods compose in the text box. Frames reach the screen through shared memory (X11) or a DIB section (Windows); an unchanged frame takes no memory.
- [Compared](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/tree/main/tools/compare): the same Hello in egui, iced and Slint, measured the same way

## For AI agents

## Examples

- [examples/](https://github.com/foxoman/retroui/tree/main/examples): Gallery (every control), Retro Photo, Retro Files, Retro Mail (Microsoft 365, Gmail, any IMAP: `retroui/imap`, `retroui/smtp`, `retroui/netconn`), Retro Communicator (XMPP chat, `retroui/xmpp`; OMEMO encryption, `retroui/omemo`), Retro Board, HR Book, Notepad, Ledger, Charts, Invoice
- [Retro Desktop](https://github.com/foxoman/retrodesktop): a Windows 3.1 desktop and window manager for Termux:X11 and Linux, made with the kit (the X11 driver's `x11EventHook`)
